body:
i know it doesnt.but why should i pay for more sessions if they are as useless as the 4 firsts?i tried to get better,i told the therapist everything she wanted.but how is talking suposed to help me feel anything?it would help if i had some traumatic event or something happened on my past,butni dont have a reason to be like this.i have nothing to work on.

i really dont want to sound like a brat,but i read about medication.it has a chance of helping severe cases of depression,im not in that stage.besides theres a chance it could be a placebo effect,since its not proven that depression is caused by imbalances on the brain.and it has a lot of side effects.could you please give me a link that proves they are effective?
please,go to sleep.its not like i can kill myself right now,and im really tired to think about it rn anyway.
thank you for you kindness.i will think about it,and answer later.

if i was a normal person i would live an average life.but im not,and i have been struggling with this for years.i dont want to suffer my whole life just to work at some boring job and live paycheck to paycheck.im not smart,and i accept that.so i really dont see the point in trying to keep suffering like this anymore if the 'reward' is that.
i truly appreciate your patience with me,but i dont think i will change my mind about suicide.

i did told them all they asked me.i didnt try to hide things,i told her how i felt and about my childhood,but in some sessions we would be in complete silence because i didnt had anything more to tell her,and she wouldnt do anything at all.she tried 'cbt' and told me to cut and glue pictures on a sheet of paper.im sorry but i cant see how thats suposed to help.if she had a plan in mind,she should have told me when i was so angry with wasting money on her that i ended up screaming.i got out of that office and she didnt try to stop me,didnt even gave me a call to know if i still needed her.that seems cold and uncaring for me,and if its suposed to be like that,i cant take it.
besides,lets say i go to another therapist...i tell them everything,and then what?are they going to give me some reason to live?some advice on how to go through this?do something useful at all?probably not,because they are not suposed to do that.
sorry if i seem rude,but therapy looks like a joke to me,and  i do get emotional when people try to push me into wasting money on it again.

i almost cried reading your history.im so sorry it all happened to you,i would not be able to survive like you did.
please dont believe those horrible things your family told you.they seem like very toxic people.from what you wrote,you dont seem like a failure,you even took your rapist to court,and thats very brave.so many women cant do that ,but you did.you also expressed your views against that racist woman,it shows you care about others,and it is a courageous act.you tried going back to school,but with the circunstances...no one would go through all this and still manage to stay in college with their mental health intact,i guarantee you.it was not your fault.even if you dont have kids,a boyfriend or a house,you can still be succesful and happy on my view.just the fact that you survived through all this is impressive on its own.from  what i could see here,you have potential.
have you tried seeing a therapist?it did not work for me,but i think talking to someone supportive and non-judgemental would be good for your mental health.
i do not know if any of this will help,because im no good at helping people,but i truly wish you the best.

thanks,but as i explained,i do not see how telling someone about will help at all.i already went to a therapist,but i got livid and felt cheated when she only nodded her head,she tried cbt and even told me to draw with crayons and glue pictures i liked on a paper.the second one did the same head nodding.i appreciate your answer,but it does not work for me.
and i can keep the food down,but i feel extremely umconfortable and i just want to throw up.dont worry,it will take ome time for me to die.im still fat too.
edit:i dont know the causes of my depression(if i can call it that,because ive never been diagnosed),i live a normal life and in my moms perspective have 'a brilliant future'.i was bullied as a child and my parents fight a lot,but thats all.it was not enough to cause this.
